```{r}
set.seed(22132)
library(mclust)
km <- Mclust(penguins2[,c("bill_dep", "bill_dep")], G = 3)

penguins2 %>% 
  mutate(cluster = km$classification) %>% 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = bill_len, y = bill_dep, color = factor(cluster))) + 
  geom_point()

```
